battle.name: 姜維北伐
battle.brief: 延熙十年（247）七月，蜀漢衛將軍姜維出隴右，接應反叛曹魏的羌胡部落，與雍州刺史郭淮、討蜀護軍夏侯霸戰於洮西，斬羌帥餓何、燒戈，收白虎文、治無戴等眾入蜀。卡面的亞述長弓並不在洮水岸，但兩軍同樣以弓弩齊發拉開陣線，亞述弓兵在車上開路、蜀軍弩手繼進，遠射兵器主導陣線的做法一脈相承。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 此役交戰的兩方是蜀漢與曹魏，戰場落在隴右洮水西岸的羌胡聚居地帶。蜀漢一方由衛將軍姜維領兵，後主劉禪坐鎮成都，中樞由尚書令、大將軍一系主持：蔣琬已卒，費禕秉政，出兵與否在朝中議過數輪，蔣琬在世時主張持重待變，費禕亦不肯輕發大軍，兵事實際由鎮漢中的姜維籌畫。軍隊沿用漢中鎮軍的編制，中軍由姜維自領，張翼、廖化等分統一線作戰，隨軍有姜維在涼州收攏的降士與整批編入的羌胡部眾，漢中、劍閣一線留兵轉運糧械。曹魏一方以雍州刺史郭淮為主將，與討蜀護軍夏侯霸在洮西迎敵；魏廷此時由曹芳在位，曹爽與司馬懿同朝秉政，涼州、雍州的羌胡首領多受魏方節制，郭淮一面用兵，一面靠招撫與討伐兼施收拾叛附的部落。雙方都不是傾國出兵的決戰，而是用偏師與羈縻部落爭奪隴右的入口。
countriesEn: The two parties in this battle were Shu-Han and Cao Wei, and the fighting took place on the west bank of the Tao River in Longyou, in a belt inhabited by Qiang and Hu tribal groups. On the Shu side the army was led by General of the Household Guard Jiang Wei, while the young emperor Liu Shan held court at Chengdu and the central government was run by the Directorate and the Senior General: Jiang Wan had already died, Fei Yi was in control, and the question of whether to send troops was argued over several times in the capital. Jiang Wan had favoured holding back and waiting for the right moment, and Fei Yi likewise refused to release large armies, so in practice the war was planned by Jiang Wei, who commanded the forces at Hanzhong. The host followed the standing garrison organisation of Hanzhong: Jiang Wei led the central army in person, Zhang Yi and Liao Hua commanded separate lines, and the marching force included surrendered soldiers gathered up in Liangzhou together with whole tribal contingents newly taken into the army, while Hanzhong and Jiange kept a garrison and forwarded grain and equipment. The Wei side was led by Guo Huai, governor of Yongzhou, who met Jiang Wei with Xia Hoba, commander for the suppression of Shu. The Wei court at the time was that of the boy emperor Cao Fang, with Cao Shuang and Sima Yi sharing power, and most of the Qiang and Hu chieftains in Liangzhou and Yongzhou were subject to Wei authority; Guo Huai fought with troops while at the same time using a mixture of conciliation and campaigning to mop up the tribes that had rebelled. Neither side committed everything to a decisive battle: both fought with detachments and with client tribal bands, and the object was the gateway into Longyou.
people: 關鍵人物是蜀漢衛將軍姜維，字伯約，天水郡冀縣人，早年曾在天水任中郎、參羌校尉，追隨襄陽太守王經南征，其後攜屬眾降蜀，諸葛亮器之，歷任護軍、輔漢將軍，諸葛亮死後統諸軍鎮漢中。他主張以攻為守，屢請北伐取涼州，此役正是他主張的第一次實戰。率部降蜀的胡人首領白虎文、治無戴等是此役的另一端：他們率部落反出魏境投蜀，姜維出隴右接應，將其眾遷入蜀境安置。魏方主將為雍州刺史郭淮，他早年隨曹操征關中，對隴右地形熟悉，此役一面抵禦姜維，一面回身討平羌胡餘黨，先後斬羌帥餓何、燒戈，收降者以萬計。討蜀護軍夏侯霸與姜維同鄉，早年在長安相善，此時卻在魏營，是兩人相識後第一次兵戎相見。張翼、廖化同屬蜀方將佐，隨軍出隴右；廖化為老將，行軍持重，張翼則力主持重待時，兩人此後在姜維歷次北伐中屢與爭議。費禕、蔣琬等中樞重臣雖未到陣，其態度直接決定姜維能取得多少兵與多少糧。
peopleEn: The central figure was Jiang Wei, General of the Household Guard of Shu-Han, courtesy name Boyue, a native of Ji County in Tianshui. He had served at Tianshui as a Gentleman of the Household and then as a commandant for the Qiang, followed Wang Jing of Xiangyang on his southern campaign, and afterwards brought his dependants across to Shu; Zhuge Liang thought highly of him and he rose to Protector of the Army and Assistant General, and after Zhuge Liang's death he took command of the army and held Hanzhong. He argued for offence in place of defence and petitioned repeatedly to attack Liangzhou, and this engagement was the first fighting carried out on that principle. The Hu chieftains who came over to Shu, notably Bai Huwen and Zhi Wudai, formed the other end of the story: they led their tribes out of Wei territory to join Shu, and Jiang Wei marched out of Longyou to meet them and then moved their people into Shu. On the Wei side the commander was Guo Huai, governor of Yongzhou, who had served under Cao Cao in the campaigns in Guanzhong and knew the terrain of Longyou intimately; here he both held off Jiang Wei and turned back to put down the remaining rebel Qiang and Hu, cutting down the Qiang commanders E He and Shao Ge and taking more than ten thousand clans and households in submission. Xia Hoba, commander for the suppression of Shu, was a fellow townsman of Jiang Wei and an old friend of his from the days in Chang'an, and now he fought against him in the field: this was the first time the two met under arms. Zhang Yi and Liao Hua were Shu officers who marched with the column into Longyou; Liao Hua was an old general who marched cautiously, while Zhang Yi argued for patience and waiting, and the two would quarrel with Jiang Wei repeatedly in the campaigns that followed. Fei Yi and Jiang Wan, though neither was on the field, sat at the centre of the capital, and their attitude decided how many men and how much grain Jiang Wei could obtain.
kits: 此戰在隴右真正起作用的是弓弩。蜀漢一線沿用漢弩體系：蹶張弩以足力張弦、單兵即可使用，強弩以槌擊發機、矢石可破甲兵，諸葛亮所製的連弩能連發數矢，木牛流馬則用來把糧草從漢中運到前線，另有偏箱車、橐駝、板車供輸卒與載糧，雲梯、衝車、望樓備於攻塞。姜維自漢中經沓中、洮水北上，補給線綿延數百里，糧秣多靠牛車與騾隊轉運，故每次出兵都受糧草牽制。騎兵是姜維的弱項，軍中馬匹多出於涼州牧場與所收羌胡部眾，人數有限，關鍵戰鬥仍靠步卒與弩手。魏方則以雍涼宿軍為主，郭淮所部弓弩齊備，騎兵與羌胡部眾可用，糧秣由長安、姑臧一線轉輸。卡面所繪的亞述長弓屬公元前七百年前後的亞述武器，以角、筋、木合製成短而有力的反曲弓，亞述軍隊正是靠弓手在車上射擊開路、車兵隨後衝擊的組合征服兩河流域。那件長弓從未到過漢中，與洮西的漢弩、蜀弓並非同一種武器，但兩者背後的原理一致：先用弓弩在遠處拉開陣線、壓制對方弓手與車兵，再讓己方車兵、步兵乘隙而進。
kitsEn: The weapons that really mattered on the banks of the Tao were bows and crossbows. The Shu line used the Chinese crossbow system: the crossbow cocked by foot (the zhuzhang nu) could be handled by a single soldier, heavy crossbows were released by a hammer striking the trigger and could punch through armour, the repeating crossbow devised by Zhuge Liang loosed several bolts in succession, and the wooden oxen and gliding horses carried grain from Hanzhong up to the front. There were also side-box carts, pack camels and flat carts for the baggage train, with scaling ladders, battering rams and watch towers kept ready for work against forts. Jiang Wei's route ran from Hanzhong through Tazhong and up the Tao valley, and the supply line stretched for several hundred li, with the grain moved by ox-carts and mule teams; that is why every sortie was constrained by fodder. Cavalry was Jiang Wei's weak point: the horses in his host came mostly from Liangzhou pastures and from the Qiang and Hu bands he had gathered, and their numbers were limited, so the decisive fighting was still done by foot soldiers and crossbowmen. The Wei army at Guo Huai's disposal consisted of veteran Yongzhou and Liangzhou troops with bows and crossbows in good order, with cavalry and tribal contingents available and grain forwarded from the Chang'an and Guzang lines. The Assyrian bow shown on the card is an Assyrian weapon of around 700 BC, a short, powerful recurve built of horn, sinew and wood, and the Assyrian army conquered the Mesopotamian riverlands precisely by combining bowmen shooting from chariots with chariot troops following behind them. That bow never reached Hanzhong and was not the same weapon as the crossbows and composite bows on the Tao, but the principle behind both is identical: open the line at distance with bows and crossbows, pin the enemy's archers and chariotry, and then let one's own chariots and foot advance into the gap.
tactics: 姜維出兵的部署大體是先出後合。他先遣部眾與先行降蜀的羌胡首領接應，自漢中出沓中，循洮水谷道北進，取道洮西一線；中軍由他自領，張翼、廖化等分領兵眾隨行，並以輕騎與斥候先行偵察郭淮的布防。洮水河谷兩側多山，道路狹窄，適合以弓弩封鎖谷口：魏軍據高列陣，弩箭自坡上壓下，蜀軍步卒以盾遮蔽前進，弩手在後列陣齊發，射畢即退入步陣掩體，再由盾兵與車陣接續推進。胡人部眾熟悉山地小徑，能在正面前開展的同時提供嚮導與側翼掩護，蜀軍不必強攻正面城塞，而以流動的部落騎兵切割魏軍的封鎖線。交戰之後，姜維沒有久據洮西，而是把白虎文、治無戴等部眾連同家眷、牲畜遷往蜀境安置，同時收攏散落的羌胡騎士充實軍隊。撤退與轉進同樣依靠山谷捷徑，後方由漢中轉出的糧車走在隊列中央，外圍以步騎護衛，避免糧道被魏軍輕騎截斷。
tacticsEn: Jiang Wei's plan was essentially to send part of the force out first and then bring the rest in. He sent troops ahead to make contact with the Qiang and Hu chieftains who had already gone over to Shu, marched out of Hanzhong by way of Tazhong, and pushed north along the valley of the Tao River to reach the line of Taoxi; he led the central army himself, with Zhang Yi, Liao Hua and others commanding separate contingents, and light cavalry and scouts went ahead to reconnoitre Guo Huai's dispositions. The valley of the Tao is hemmed in by mountains and its roads are narrow, which suits an archery screen across the mouth of the valley: the Wei troops took high ground and loosed volleys of bolts down the slopes, while the Shu infantry advanced under cover of shields, with crossbowmen drawn up behind them to fire in unison and then fall back into the protection of the foot line, shield troops and cart formations taking over the advance. The barbarian bands knew the mountain tracks and could serve as guides and cover for the flanks while the front was engaged, so the Shu army did not have to assault a fortified position head-on; mobile tribal horsemen cut through the Wei blocking line instead. After the fighting Jiang Wei did not stay long at Taoxi: he moved Bai Huwen, Zhi Wudai and their people, with families and livestock, into Shu territory, and gathered scattered Qiang and Hu riders into the army. Withdrawal and advance alike used the mountain shortcuts, with the grain carts forwarded from Hanzhong in the middle of the column and infantry and cavalry on the flanks, so that the food line could not be cut by Wei light horse.
data: 此役發生在蜀漢延熙十年、曹魏正始八年，即公元二四七年，距蜀漢建國已二十六年，距諸葛亮卒於五丈原十二年。姜維本人生於二〇二年，是年四十五歲。戰場在今甘肅洮水上游的洮源、卓尼一帶；自漢中到洮西，直線約四百公里，循谷道實際近千里，糧秣全靠人力車隊與騾馬轉輸。兵員方面，維基百科條目為整個姜維北伐系列所附的傷亡欄記蜀軍損失上萬、魏軍數萬人，並註明雙方兵力不詳；此役本身未見詳細編制記載，通鑑系於姜維出隴右一段而未列軍數。戰果方面有較明確的數字：郭淮討羌，斬羌帥餓何、燒戈，收服者萬餘落，落為部落的編制單位；姜維接應並遷入蜀境的胡人首領，以白虎文、治無戴等數部為主。整個系列則自二三八年至二六二年共十一次出兵，規模由數千至數萬不等。
dataEn: The engagement took place in the tenth year of the Yan reign in Shu-Han, the eighth year of Zhengshi in Cao Wei, that is AD 247, twenty-six years after the foundation of Shu-Han and twelve years after Zhuge Liang died at Wuzhangyuan. Jiang Wei himself was born in 202 and was forty-five years old. The battlefield lay in the upper valley of the Tao, in what is now Tanyuan and Zhuoni in Gansu; the distance from Hanzhong to Taoxi is about four hundred kilometres in a straight line and close to a thousand along the valley road, and every grain had to be hauled by cart and mule. On numbers: the casualties field in the Chinese Wikipedia article for the Jiang Wei northern expeditions as a whole lists more than ten thousand lost by Shu and tens of thousands by Wei, with the strengths of both sides given as unknown; this engagement itself has no detailed order of battle, and the Zizhi Tongjian simply records that Jiang Wei marched out into Longyou without listing the numbers. The results are better documented: Guo Huai struck at the Qiang, cut down the Qiang commanders E He and Shao Ge, and brought more than ten thousand clans and households into submission, the clan (luo) being the unit of tribal settlement; the Hu chieftains who came over to Shu and were moved into Shu territory by Jiang Wei were headed by Bai Huwen and Zhi Wudai with several other bands. For the series as a whole, Jiang Wei campaigned eleven times between 238 and 262, with armies ranging from a few thousand to tens of thousands.
cause: 此役的起因有三層。第一層是諸葛亮死後的權力真空：建興十二年亮卒五丈原，蜀漢以姜維統諸軍鎮漢中，卻仍由蔣琬、費禕主持中樞，主守不主戰，姜維屢請出兵而不得全軍。第二層是涼州、雍州一線的羌胡反叛：曹魏在雍涼二州安置大量羌胡部落，用以守邊；然聚居既久，徵發與安置的糾紛積累，部落首領白虎文、治無戴等遂率眾反出魏境，改投蜀漢，姜維得以名正言順出兵接應，將涼州人口與騎兵收入囊中。第三層是姜維的戰略目標：蜀漢地狹民少，長遠守禦漢中必然消耗更重，故須反覆出隴右、爭涼州，並以遷徙部落、實行屯田解決兵源與糧源。三層交織，構成了延熙十年秋洮西一戰的直接動因：姜維要接人，也要在魏境樹立一個可以反覆出入的立足點。
causeEn: Three layers of cause lie behind this battle. The first is the power vacuum that followed Zhuge Liang's death: in the twelfth year of Jianxing the chancellor died at Wuzhangyuan, Shu-Han left Jiang Wei commanding the army at Hanzhong, but the capital was still run by Jiang Wan and Fei Yi, who preferred to hold and wait rather than attack; Jiang Wei petitioned again and again for an offensive and was not given the whole army. The second is the rebellion of the Qiang and Hu in Liangzhou and Yongzhou: Cao Wei had settled large numbers of Qiang and Hu tribes in Yong and Liang to hold the frontier, and after long residence the friction over levies and resettlement piled up, so chieftains such as Bai Huwen and Zhi Wudai led their people out of Wei territory and over to Shu. That gave Jiang Wei a legitimate reason to march out into Longyou and to take in Liangzhou's people and horses. The third is Jiang Wei's own strategic aim: Shu-Han was small and poor, and a purely defensive posture at Hanzhong would drain it further in the long run, so he needed to go out into Longyou again and again, contest Liangzhou, and solve the problem of men and grain by moving tribes in and opening up fields. The three threads meet in the direct cause of the fighting on the Tao in the autumn of the tenth year of Yan: Jiang Wei needed to meet the people who were coming over, and he needed to establish on Wei's side of the frontier a foothold he could use again and again.
impact: 洮西一役的影響超出一次邊戰的範圍。對蜀漢而言，姜維首次在隴右成功接應並遷入整批羌胡人口與騎兵，等於在涼州方向取得第一批實力，數年後他兼領涼州刺史、在洮西一帶屯田經營，兵力與糧源都與這次收編直接相關；此後他以洮水、石營、狄道為軸心的十一次北伐路線由此成形，也把蜀漢的國力一點一點推向消耗。對曹魏而言，郭淮平定羌胡餘黨、斬其二帥、降服萬餘落，暫時堵住隴右的缺口，並把部分叛附部眾遷往關中安置，涼州防線得以維持；此後陳泰在雍州經營屯田、斷絕關梁險要、絕姜維運道，思路正源於此戰之後的教訓。放到三國全局，姜維的反覆北伐使蜀漢上下厭戰、士氣漸衰，宦官黃皓乘勢掌權、把持朝政，終致二六三年魏軍滅蜀；而北伐牽制曹魏主力、消耗其國力，也為司馬氏在中原坐大、進而代魏鋪平了道路。一場為接應叛附而打的邊戰，就此拉開了兩個政權十餘年的消耗。
impactEn: The effects of Taoxi reached well beyond a border skirmish. For Shu-Han, Jiang Wei's first successful reception and resettlement of whole Qiang and Hu populations and horsemen in Longyou gave him a real force on the Liangzhou front; a few years later he took up the post of governor of Liangzhou and worked the fields along the Tao, and both his troops and his supplies grew directly out of that intake. His later campaigns, pivoted on the Tao, Shiying and Didao, took their shape from it, and the same process steadily drained Shu-Han's strength. For Cao Wei, Guo Huai's suppression of the remaining rebel Qiang and Hu, the death of their two commanders and the submission of more than ten thousand clans bought time, and the transfer of some of the rebel settlers into Guanzhong kept the Liangzhou line intact; the measures taken afterwards in Yongzhou, with Chen Tai opening fields, cutting the mountain passes at the vital points and severing Jiang Wei's supply road, grew directly out of the lesson of this battle. In the wider Three Kingdoms picture, Jiang Wei's repeated offensives wore down Shu-Han, the troops grew weary of the war and the eunuch Huang Hao took power at court, and in 263 the Wei armies destroyed Shu. Meanwhile the northern campaigns kept Wei's field armies occupied and drained her resources, paving the way for the Sima family's rise in the central plain and the eventual replacement of Cao Wei by Jin. A border war fought to pick up a rebel tribe thus opened some fifteen years of attrition between the two states.
result: 結果是姜維在洮西取得了實質性的收穫。《華陽國志校補圖注七》記「衛將軍姜維出隴西，與魏將郭淮、夏侯霸戰，克之」，明言此役蜀軍獲勝；通鑑同段則記姜維斬羌胡首領，白虎文、治無戴等率眾來降，姜維盡徙其眾入蜀境，部落家眷與牲畜隨行安置。郭淮未能阻止姜維與降眾會合，轉而回師討平羌胡餘黨，斬餓何、燒戈，收服萬餘落，勉強把局面扳平，但隴右游離的羌胡已大量轉入蜀漢一方，涼州前線從此更形敏感。姜維沒有乘勢攻取城塞、擴大戰果，見好即收，保留實力再圖下次，這也成了他其後十次北伐一貫的作風：一役小勝之後照舊退兵整頓，再以糧道、屯田與部落羈縻為下一輪的資本。延熙十年的洮西之役因此是姜維北伐系列中早期少數實質勝利的一役：它證明蜀軍能在隴右站住腳，也同時顯示以偏師深入、仰賴羈縻的北伐，始終難以取代正面的城池攻取。
resultEn: The outcome was that Jiang Wei gained real substance at Taoxi. The Huayang Guozhi with its commentary records that 'General of the Household Guard Jiang Wei marched out into Longyou and defeated the Wei generals Guo Huai and Xia Hoba', stating plainly that the Shu army won; the Zizhi Tongjian for the same stretch records that Jiang Wei struck down the Qiang and Hu chieftains and that Bai Huwen, Zhi Wudai and others came over with their people, whom Jiang Wei moved into Shu territory along with their families and livestock. Guo Huai could not prevent the meeting of Jiang Wei with the incoming tribal bands and turned instead to put down the remaining rebel Qiang and Hu, cutting down E He and Shao Ge and taking more than ten thousand clans into submission; the situation was roughly restored, but the Qiang and Hu of Longyou had gone over to Shu in bulk, and the Liangzhou front became far more sensitive from that point on. Jiang Wei did not press his advantage to take walled positions or enlarge the result, and withdrew as soon as he had what he came for, keeping his force in hand for the next round: that became his habitual pattern in the ten campaigns that followed, winning a small battle, withdrawing to reform, and then treating the supply route, the farms and the tribal alliances as the capital for the next attempt. The engagement of 247 at Taoxi is therefore one of the few substantive victories in the early northern expeditions of Jiang Wei: it showed that the Shu army could hold its ground in Longyou, and at the same time it showed that offensives carried out with detachments and resting on client tribes could never take the place of a frontal assault on the fortified towns.
